book.name: Lum
book.title: Ŋwa wù Bol gɛ̀ saŋ fɛ kintaashɛ ki Lum le

content: Gɛ Nyo mo wu ma lo bamii ba Ishwala gɛ
Ŋka mbiide lɛ laa Nyo le wu ma wa lo bamii be la? Gɛ nyume noo gɛ! Mɛ kibɛɛ nle muh wu Ishwala. Nle mwa Ablaham, mbu kfuu chi Bɛnjamɛ le.
Gɛ Nyo nyume wu ma lo bamii be ba wu gɛ̀ cha wa baaŋ lo gɛ. Gɛ bɛŋ kee fiɛɛ fì Ŋwa wu Nyo jɛme kune Alaja no wu gɛ̀ beede fɛ Nyo le kune fiɛɛ fì bamii ba Ishwala gɛ̀ gee le gɛ?
Wu gɛ̀ beede wu duu Nyo le lɛ,

content.text: “Tada, ba le ba yuuyɛ wa bamii buŋ ba ntuŋ,
ba saayɛ bitana biuŋ bi bintanyɛ lɛ.
Shɛɛ gɛh mɛ maa,
bo ka bii wa tɛ mɛne ki bo mɛ̂sɛ lo.”

content: Wu gɛ̀ beede noo Nyo chvuu wu le lɛ la? Wu gɛ̀ chvuu wu le lɛ,

content.text: “Nle ŋgɛɛ bamii ba le baŋ banchvuge bvusooshwi (7,000),
bo gɛ̀ baaŋ a tuŋ gɛ anyuu a fimooso fwe ki bo buuŋ fi gɛ.”

content: Le gɛh yɛɛŋyɛɛŋ no fi le kife ki kimɛɛse kinɛ le. Bamii bamu le gɛh yu Ishwala shige ba shɛshi nyume ba Nyo. Bo banɛ wu cha nje fitele fì joŋe.
Nɛ fi le lɛ wu gɛ̀ cha nje fitele fì joŋe, tu gɛ ka nyume nje lɛme chimi chì bo gɛ̀ ge gɛ. Nɛ gɛ̀ bee nje lɛme chimi chì bo gɛ̀ ge, tu gɛ taŋlo ka nyu lɛ le fitele fì joŋe gɛ.

Fiɛɛ fì njɛme le lɛ la? Fi le lɛ bamii ba Ishwala ba duude gɛ̀ baaŋ to gɛ̀ bo nyume chaaŋ a Nyo jii no bo gɛ goone gɛ. Gɛ̀ bee gɛh bamii ba Nyo gɛ̀ cha bo, bo gɛ̀ to bo kɛme je ki bo nyu chaaŋ a wu jii. Geenɛ, Nyo ge muntele mu kimbege ki bamii tɛmɛ mu gha mu mɛ noo.
Finɛ le no ba gɛ̀ saŋ lɛ,

content.text: “Nyo gɛ̀ ge lɛ bo tu bo yuŋfe,
ajii aboo ka yɛde gɛ mwɛɛ le gɛ,
bintuŋ biboo ka yuge gɛ mwɛɛ gɛ.
Bo tu bo nyume gɛh noo too bude abɛŋ.”

content: Dabi gɛ̀ be wu jɛmɛ tɛ lɛ,

content.text: “Nyo fɛ̂ mwɛɛ munjile mù bo jii bo yuge njoŋ,
mu dîiŋ bo njɛ labe,
mu ka mu kôo bo njɛ kintase.
Mu tû fiɛɛ fì ba baŋsɛ yu ba gwe,
mo nyûme nlaŋɛ wu gee chiboo.
Nyo gê ajii aboo jiiŋ wu lɛ keefɛ bo ka bo yɛ̂ne mwɛɛ le gɛ.
Wu ka wu gê tɛ jíŋ yiboo ŋgvûusɛ yi mɛ noo.”

content: Ntu nto mbiide laa fi le lɛ bamii ba Ishwala gɛ̀ baŋsɛ nɛ bo gwe bo mɛ lo fɛkuu? Gɛ nyume noo gɛ. Kimbefɛ kì bo gɛ̀ ge ka ki to lo bɛ mbvusɛ fɛ bamii ba le gɛ Bajuu le gɛ, wu lɛ bamii ba Ishwala bɛ̂ɛne kindoŋ.

Nɛ fi le lɛ kimbefɛ kì bo gɛ̀ ge ka ki to nyu bɛ bvukugɛ yi nshɛŋ le, ŋgwe wù bo gɛ̀ gwe to nyume bɛ bvukugɛ fɛ bamii ba le gɛ Bajuu le gɛ, tu bvukugɛ bvù lé bvu nyûme sege bamii ba le gɛ Bajuu gɛ bachii bɛɛŋ Kletu le, lé bvu gê bvu nyûme nɛɛ?
Keefɛ bamii ba le gɛ ba Ishwala mobo kfuune gvuu bɛ bamii ba Ishwala gɛ
Ŋkoŋe ki njɛmɛ mɛɛse nyume bɛŋ bamii ba le gɛ Bajuu gɛ. No nle mwa ntuŋ wu Jiso fɛ bamii ba le gɛ ba Ishwala le gɛ, mɛ mo jode lɛme chaŋ lɛ le fiɛɛ fì kuge.
Ŋgee noo wu lɛ ŋgê Bajuu besa bɛ̂ɛne kindoŋ, fi kûŋ bo le, bamu bo le ge bo bonɛ.

Nɛ fi le lɛ Nyo gɛ doo wu faŋ bamii ba Ishwala finɛ ge bamii bamu yi woŋ le bo kaasɛ bo tu fiɛɛ fimimia bɛ Nyo, tu sege wu kaasɛ wu fi bo, fi nyume nɛɛ? Fi nyume lo njɛ sege muh kwe wu kaasɛ wu bu yi kwe le.
Nɛ muh bwɛɛde bvulɛɛŋ wu baa sa Nyo le, tu bvulɛɛŋ bvuyu bvuchii le wa bvu Nyo. Kite nɛ le gɛŋ yiyu nyume yi Nyo, tu chɛ́ yi kite kiyu le tɛ yi Nyo.

Geenɛ, nɛ fi le lɛ chɛ́ yi kite yimi le ba gɛ̀ shwagɛ ba jo wa nyu bɛŋ ba le chɛ́ yi kite ki olif ki a ko, ba shuuyɛ yi kite ki olif ki ba yile lo le fɛ chɛ́ yimi chiɛɛ ja fo, wu lɛ bɛŋ kɛ̂me tɛ joo yi jade yi kite kiyu le,
tu gɛ bɛŋ kɛme ki bɛŋ kfûune gvuu bena chɛ́ yiyu chiɛɛ gɛ. Nɛ bɛŋ kfuune gvuu bena bo, bɛŋ kwâji lɛ bɛŋ le gɛh lo chɛ́. Gɛ gee bɛŋ lɛ gɛŋ nyûme yu gɛ. Le gɛŋ yì gee fɛ bɛŋ nyûme yu.
Taŋlo muh mu bɛŋ le ja wu jɛmɛ lɛ, “Ba gɛ̀ shwage chɛ́ ki ba chvuu nyume mɛ fo.”
Le nchiɛɛŋ. Ba gɛ̀ shwage ba nooŋ nje gɛ bo kɛme mbɛmɛ gɛ. Bɛŋ le fo bɛŋ tɛɛme nje fitele fì bɛŋ leese yi Kletu le. Noo, keefɛ bɛŋ mo bɛŋ chîaase ye gɛ. Bɛŋ nyûme gɛh nfaaŋ nfaaŋ.
Bɛŋ kêe lɛ nɛ Nyo gɛ̀ baaŋ bajɛ gɛ chɛ́ yi kite kì ba yile lo kɛɛ gɛ, tu gɛ taŋlo tɛ wu gê wu bâjɛ bɛŋ gɛ.

Bɛŋ jîŋɛ bɛŋ yɛ̂ŋ no Nyo kɛme fitele fì joŋe baaŋ wu ka kɛme tɛ fitele fì luji. Wu to wu luji bɛ bamii ba le bo gwe, geenɛ wu duunyi fitele fì joŋe fɛ bɛŋ fɛnɛ le bɛŋ mɛ gɛh bɛŋ bii je ye le. Nɛ fuge noo sɛŋ, tu wu lé wu gê wu shwâgɛ tɛ bɛŋ wu nôŋ.
Doo tu fɛ bamii ba Ishwala le, bo nɛ kuse lo bo kɛme mbɛmɛ, Nyo kaasɛ wu jo bo wu shuuyɛ yi kite kɛɛ le, nje le fiɛɛ Nyo kɛme bvuŋga ki wu kâasɛ wu ge.

Bɛŋ kêe lɛ, nɛ bɛŋ le chɛ́ yì ba gɛ̀ shwagɛ yi kite ki olif kì kuu nyu a ko, ba to ba shuuyɛ yi kì ba gɛ̀ yilɛ lo le, nyume gɛ fiɛɛ fì kɛme ki fi nyûme noo gɛ, tu gɛ taŋlo ba kaasɛ ba jo chɛ́ yì le yi kite kì ba yile lo yi ba gɛ̀ shwagɛ wa ba kaasɛ ba chvuu yi kite kiyu le ba fe lo noo?
Nyo le wu koo yii fɛ bamii ba Ishwala le bachii

Booŋ ba bwɛɛŋ, ŋgoone lɛ bɛŋ kɛɛ nchiɛɛŋ wunɛ wù le nyilɛ le, wu lɛ keefɛ bɛŋ jâ bɛŋ bɛ̂ɛŋse ye lɛ bɛŋ feefe baaŋ gɛ. Fi le lɛ kikwɛɛ ki tɛmɛ le ki to fɛ bamii bamu ba Ishwala le. Bo lé bo gê bo tɛ̂ɛme bikwɛɛ noo gɛɛŋ bu sege bamii ba le gɛ Bajuu gɛ bachii ba kɛme ki bo lee ŋgoo yi bamii ba Kletu le bo lee wa.
Fi lé fi gê doo fi kôoshɛ noo, bamii ba Ishwala bachii mo bo bonɛ. Le fi fì ba gɛ̀ saŋ Nyo duu lɛ,

content.text: “Muh wù lé wu gê wu bvûsɛ bamii yi ŋgɛ le, lé wu gê wu bû Sayoŋ.
Wu lé wu gê wu bvûsɛ gee chì befe a kfuu chi Yakob le.
Finɛ fiɛɛ le maŋkaŋ mà nlé ŋgê ŋgwô besa bo,
sege nchiaasɛ bimbefɛ biboo.”

content: Kune no saaka wù joŋe wu Nyo le, bamii ba Ishwala le bamii ba kimbanɛ fɛ Nyo le nje bɛŋ. Kune ncha wù Nyo gɛ̀ cha wa bo, nyu bamii ba Ishwala le lo fitele fie nje maŋkaŋ mà wu gɛ̀ gwo bɛ bachiji chiji bo.
Fi le noo nje Nyo nya nnya muh le, wu gɛ ka wu kaasɛ wu fi gɛ, wu tɛɛŋ wa muh, wu gɛ ka wu kaasɛ wu chinɛ wu le gɛ.
No bɛŋ bamii ba le gɛ ba Ishwala gɛ, bɛŋ gɛ̀ shee bɛŋ yuge gɛ Nyo le gɛ, geenɛ tu nyu mɛɛse wu koo wa yii fɛ bɛŋ le nje bamii ba Ishwala baaŋ gɛ̀ bo yugɛ wu le gɛ,
le gɛh yɛɛŋyɛɛŋ no bo tɛ baaŋ gɛ̀ bo yuge Nyo le mɛɛse gɛ, wu lɛ yii yì wu kɛme fɛ bɛŋ le yi gê wu kôo tɛ yii fɛ bo le.
Fiɛɛ fì nyume le lɛ, Nyo le wu leesɛ bamii bachii yi ncha wu kikwɛɛ ki tɛmɛ le, wu lɛ taŋlo wu koo yii fɛ bo le bachii.
Nyuusɛ nyume fɛ Nyo le

Oo, bɛŋ jiŋɛ bɛŋ yɛŋ, bvukugɛ bvù le bvu Nyo, le lo bvù baaŋ, bvufee bwe le tɛ bvù baaŋ, mwɛɛ mù wu kee le wu kee tɛ baaŋ! Gɛ taŋlo muh kɛ̂ɛ je yì wu seese mwɛɛ yu gɛ. Gɛ taŋlo muh kɛɛ je yì wu gee mwɛɛ mwe yu gɛ.
Finɛ le no ba saŋ a Ŋwa wu Nyo le lɛ,

content.text: “Le yɛɛŋ wuyu wù kee ŋkwajɛ wu Tada?
Kɛnɛ le yɛɛŋ wù taŋlo wu têfɛ wu?
Le yɛɛŋ wuyu wù gɛ̀ nya wa Nyo bɛ fiɛɛ,
wu lɛ Nyo kâasɛ wu chvûu wu le?”

content: Mwɛɛ munchii ja fɛ wu le. Mwɛɛ munchii fede chiaaŋ ye le, mwɛɛ munchii le nje wu. Mbɛɛŋsɛ nyûme fɛ wu le segechii wu kage gɛ. Fi nyûme noo.
